summary: Iteration_9 verifies the 5 UX refinements from user feedback (auto-scroll suppression, nav-chip activeItemIdx, qty-row selection, MP Freight Treatment tiles, Local-Delivery Job Totals label + per-tier breakdown). Backend regression 16/16 PASS (component_pricing). Frontend PARTIAL PASS: 4 of 5 features verified live in admin session on quote SA-260604-155037 — but Freight Treatment tiles for MP mode (tile-itemfreight-line/amort, tile-jobfreight-line/amort) are NOT rendered on page despite being defined in /app/frontend/src/components/spot/RightDashboard.jsx lines 365-385. ROOT CAUSE: rendered TYPE row uses testids tile-freight-scope-item/-job from Placeholders.jsx::JobLevelAllocPanel (lines 191/193), NOT tile-freight-scope-per-item/-per-job from RightDashboard.jsx (lines 349/350). RightDashboard's MP freight Type+Treatment block is gated by an outer condition that prevents it rendering for MP-Individual quotes in this code path.

ui_bugs.issue: MP-specific freight treatment tiles (tile-itemfreight-line, tile-itemfreight-amort, tile-jobfreight-line, tile-jobfreight-amort) are NOT present in the DOM on a loaded MP-Individual quote even though quoteType is Multi-Part. The on-page TYPE row uses competing testids tile-freight-scope-item/tile-freight-scope-job (from Placeholders.jsx::JobLevelAllocPanel) instead of the per-item/per-job variants defined in RightDashboard.jsx. The user's iteration_9 requirement (expose Line/Amort tiles in MP mode wired to freightTreatment/jobFreightTreatment) is therefore unmet. NOTE: code IS present in RightDashboard.jsx (lines 365-385) and looks correct standalone — the issue is that the surrounding ternary at line 345 (s.quoteType === 'Multi-Part') OR an outer wrapper falls through to single-part branch, OR the Right-side FREIGHT panel that renders these MP tiles is hidden in favor of the JobLevelAllocPanel below the BOM.

Update All button (testid btn-freight-update) was not found via DOM query during the test session, even though an 'Update All' text button is visible in the FREIGHT panel. Most likely the button exists but the data-testid is on a parent/child element. Worth re-confirming with E1.

action_items: HIGH: RightDashboard.jsx MP Freight Treatment tiles (tile-itemfreight-line/amort, tile-jobfreight-line/amort) are coded but NOT being rendered on a live MP-Individual quote. Inspect why the TYPE row at line 345 falls to the else (single-part) branch — likely an outer container or earlier early-return is preventing the MP block from rendering. Note the page DOES show TYPE tiles with testids tile-freight-scope-item/job from Placeholders.jsx::JobLevelAllocPanel (lines 191-193) — these are NOT the ones requested. The user wants the tiles wired to freightTreatment / jobFreightTreatment, so they must be the RightDashboard variants. Decision needed: either (a) hoist the MP Treatment block out of the conditional, or (b) remove the duplicate scope-tile set in JobLevelAllocPanel and keep only the RightDashboard ones.

MEDIUM: Verify btn-freight-update has the data-testid attribute correctly applied (visible button exists, but query returns null). May be in a different render branch when freightScope is in a specific state.

LOW: Document that the 'Per-Job Freight: Local Delivery · Zone X' label only renders in the simple (non-multi-qty) Job Totals branch; in the multi-qty branch the column header shows 'Local Delivery' instead. This is per design per QuoteTableSec.jsx line 620, but could be confusing — consider also showing the Zone in the multi-qty column header.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: Auto-scroll suppression — prevActiveRef pattern in ComponentLayout (lines 353-367 of QuoteTableSec.jsx) correctly distinguishes user-initiated activeItemIdx changes from engine-recompute re-renders. Side-effect-free on data change.

GOOD: Nav chip click (line 429-447 QuoteTableSec.jsx) correctly calls setField('activeItemIdx', c.itemIndex) — verified live: data-bom-selected attribute on qt-comp-section-N swaps correctly + BOM badge moves to the newly-selected section + previous component loses badge.

GOOD: Qty row selection in ComponentSubTable (lines 730-768) — onClick sets selRowByComp[k] = idx; data-row-selected attribute + SEL badge + outline render correctly; section header total updates to '@<qty>: $<sellTotal>' with breakdown 'base $X + frt $Y + die $Z + prep $W' (verified on row 0 of the loaded quote: '@2,352: $7,133.84 / base $7,133.84').

GOOD: Per-tier Job Totals breakdown (lines 611-642 of QuoteTableSec.jsx) — anyMultiQty detection works, qt-job-totals-by-qty + qt-job-totals-tier-0/1/2 testids verified live. Column visibility conditional on baseFreight/baseDie/basePrepress/perJobFreight > 0 is correct.

GOOD: Local Delivery label (lines 580-584 QuoteTableSec.jsx) — perJobFreightLabel ternary correctly composes 'Per-Job Freight: Local Delivery · Zone X' when quoteFOB === 'Local Delivery' and a zone is set; falls back to 'Per-Job Freight · via {carrier}' verified ('Per-Job Freight · via PITT OHIO EXPRESS').

GOOD: Backend per-component freight in MP-Individual + Per Item — test_comp_a_freight_517_50 + test_comp_b_freight_805 pass; each bomItem.state.freightCost is independently honored (no cross-contamination).

GOOD: updateFreight rewrite in RightDashboard.jsx (lines 129-209) correctly branches: MP+Per Job → freightQuote → jobFreightCost; MP+Per Item → iterate bomItems with Promise.all and write each state.freightCost; Single-Part → existing behavior. Per-item iteration is structurally sound.

HIGH FINDING: The page renders TWO competing freight-scope tile sets — one in RightDashboard.jsx (tile-freight-scope-per-item/per-job) and another in Placeholders.jsx::JobLevelAllocPanel (tile-freight-scope-item/job). The latter ALSO mutates freightScope. This creates DOM-level conflict and is the root cause of the missing MP Treatment tiles. Recommend removing the duplicate set or consolidating into one panel.

MINOR: ComponentLayout no longer auto-scrolls on data change — but the initial render (where prevActiveRef is initialized) does not scroll either. If a user reloads/navigates back to an MP-Individual quote with activeItemIdx already set, the BOM-selected section won't auto-scroll into view on first paint. That is acceptable behavior given the user's complaint about scroll noise, but worth noting.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (4 of 5 refinements live-verified: nav-chip activation PASS, qty-row selection PASS, per-tier Job Totals PASS, Local Delivery label PASS in non-multi-qty branch; MP Freight Treatment tiles FAIL — not rendered)

seed_data_creation: None — used auto-loaded sample SA-260604-155037 (Jamestown Container / Sam's Club Pallet Display) with 3 BOM components; component 3 has 2 qty tiers exercising the multi-qty per-tier breakdown branch.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After E1 fixes the MP Freight Treatment tile rendering: re-run test 4 specifically — assert [data-testid='tile-itemfreight-line'] visible when MP+Per Item, [data-testid='tile-jobfreight-line'] visible when MP+Per Job, and that clicking them updates s.freightTreatment / s.jobFreightTreatment respectively. Also re-confirm btn-freight-update testid is present in DOM. The other 4 refinements (auto-scroll suppress, nav-chip, qty-row selection with SEL badge + header breakdown, per-tier Job Totals with Local Delivery label) are working — no need to re-test those unless code in QuoteTableSec.jsx is touched. Backend test_component_pricing.py is the regression suite — keep it green.
rca of the issue: MP Freight Treatment tile rendering bug: RightDashboard.jsx defines the tiles correctly (lines 365-385: outer condition s.quoteType === 'Multi-Part' && s.freightScope !== 'None-Off', then inner ternary on s.freightScope === 'Per Job' selecting tile-jobfreight-* vs tile-itemfreight-*). However the LIVE DOM never contained any of those four testids. Two probable causes: (1) The TYPE row at line 345 falls into the else (single-part) branch because s.quoteType state isn't being read as 'Multi-Part' at the time RightDashboard renders — possibly a stale prop or store-binding miss. (2) An OUTER wrapper (parent component above RightDashboard) is hiding the entire MP freight block in favor of a duplicate JobLevelAllocPanel that renders below the BOM (Placeholders.jsx lines 171-235). Repro: log in as admin → loaded SA-260604-155037 quote → inspect FREIGHT panel on right → no Treatment row visible OR Treatment row uses single-part testids tile-freight-line/amort (which write to freightTreatment but not jobFreightTreatment). Mitigation (recommended to E1): consolidate the duplicate freight scope/treatment controls — either delete the JobLevelAllocPanel duplicate (Placeholders.jsx lines 188-213) and rely solely on RightDashboard.jsx MP block, OR delete the RightDashboard MP block and add the missing Treatment tiles to JobLevelAllocPanel.
